component.name: VideoScene
component.script:
' LXC 118 serves both the live stream and the remote's peek images. function host() as String return "http://192.168.139.19:8080" end function
' pub serves the settings endpoint the remote's Left/Right writes to. function pub() as String return "http://pub.lan" end function
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("player") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.retryTimer = m.top.findNode("retryTimer") m.retryTimer.observeField("fire", "onRetry")
' The remote's peek (#80, ADR-0012): Up/Down shows another pane at ' once as an image over the live video; Back, or a minute without a ' press, returns to the live view. It only looks: the stream keeps ' showing what the compositor decided. m.peek = m.top.findNode("peek") m.bar = m.top.findNode("bar") m.caption = m.top.findNode("caption") m.idleTimer = m.top.findNode("idleTimer") m.idleTimer.observeField("fire", "closePeek") m.items = [] m.index = -1 m.mode = "" ' "", "peek" (Up/Down) or "default" (Left/Right) m.pending = invalid ' a default resting pane chosen but not yet saved m.postTimer = m.top.findNode("postTimer") m.postTimer.observeField("fire", "postDefault") m.lineup = m.top.findNode("lineup") m.lineup.observeField("content", "onLineup") m.lineup.url = host() + "/peek/index.json" m.lineup.control = "run"
startPlayback() ' The scene, not the Video node, takes the remote: a focused Video ' answers OK, Play and the arrows with trick play on a live stream. m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub startPlayback() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = host() + "/master.m3u8" content.streamformat = "hls" content.live = true m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" end sub
' Publisher restarts kill the HLS session server-side; the Video node ' lands in "error" (or "finished") and never retries on its own. sub onVideoState() s = m.video.state if s = "error" or s = "finished" m.video.control = "stop" m.retryTimer.control = "start" end if end sub
sub onRetry() startPlayback() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "up" then stepPeek(-1) return true else if key = "down" then stepPeek(1) return true else if key = "left" then chooseDefault(-1) return true else if key = "right" then chooseDefault(1) return true else if key = "back" then ' Back closes a peek (dropping a default not yet saved) and ' otherwise does nothing, so a stray press can't exit the channel ' and leave the screen on the Roku home screen. (Home still leaves; ' Roku apps can't catch it.) closePeek() return true end if return false end function
' A new line-up from LXC 118. A peek in progress stays on the same pane ' if it is still listed, and closes if it left. sub onLineup() doc = ParseJson(m.lineup.content) if doc = invalid or type(doc.items) <> "roArray" then return current = invalid if m.peek.visible and m.index >= 0 and m.index < m.items.Count() then current = m.items[m.index].id m.items = doc.items if current = invalid then return m.index = findItem(current) ' A refresh is not a press: the idle countdown carries on. if m.index < 0 then closePeek() else if m.mode = "default" then showImage(m.items[m.index]) else showItem() end if end sub
function findItem(id as String) as Integer for i = 0 to m.items.Count() - 1 if m.items[i].id = id then return i end for return -1 end function
' Step through the line-up (rubric order). The first step starts from the ' pane on screen, so Down shows the next one below it; steps wrap around. sub stepPeek(delta as Integer) n = m.items.Count() if n = 0 then m.peek.visible = false showCaption("Nothing to step through yet") restartIdle() return end if if not m.peek.visible then m.index = -1 for i = 0 to n - 1 if m.items[i].showing <> invalid and m.items[i].showing = true then m.index = i end for if m.index < 0 and delta < 0 then m.index = 0 end if m.index = m.index + delta if m.index < 0 then m.index = n - 1 if m.index >= n then m.index = 0 m.mode = "peek" showItem() restartIdle() end sub
' Left/Right on the main view picks the household's default resting pane ' (#83, ADR-0013): it cycles the line-up's ambient items in a fixed order, ' by id (#86), starting from the one on screen (or, while something urgent ' is up, the current default). The choice is saved to the rubric's ' settings a moment after the last press; urgent panes still take over. sub chooseDefault(delta as Integer) ' The line-up puts the default first, so its order moves with every ' save; sorting by id keeps Left and Right going the same way round. resting = [] for i = 0 to m.items.Count() - 1 if m.items[i]["class"] = "ambient" then resting.Push({id: m.items[i].id, i: i}) end for resting.SortBy("id") n = resting.Count() if n = 0 then m.peek.visible = false showCaption("No resting panes to choose from yet") restartIdle() return end if if m.mode <> "default" then m.choice = -1 for k = 0 to n - 1 item = m.items[resting[k].i] if item.showing <> invalid and item.showing = true then m.choice = k end for if m.choice < 0 then m.choice = 0 for k = 0 to n - 1 item = m.items[resting[k].i] if item["default"] <> invalid and item["default"] = true then m.choice = k end for end if if n > 1 then m.choice = m.choice + delta ' the first press moves off the current one else m.choice = m.choice + delta end if if m.choice < 0 then m.choice = n - 1 if m.choice >= n then m.choice = 0 m.mode = "default" m.index = resting[m.choice].i item = m.items[m.index] showImage(item) position = m.choice + 1 m.choiceText = "Left/Right Default: " + item.title + " " + position.ToStr() + " of " + n.ToStr() if n = 1 then showCaption(m.choiceText + " · the only resting pane Back: live view") else m.pending = item.id showCaption(m.choiceText + " · saving… Back: cancel") m.postTimer.control = "start" end if restartIdle() end sub
' The pause after the last Left/Right is over: save the choice. sub postDefault() if m.pending = invalid then return m.signal = CreateObject("roSGNode", "SignalTask") m.signal.observeField("status", "onSaved") m.signal.url = pub() + "/api/signals/rubric" m.signal.body = FormatJson({id: "default.pane", action: "set", label: m.pending}) m.pending = invalid m.signal.control = "run" end sub
sub onSaved() if m.mode <> "default" then return code = m.signal.status if code = 200 then showCaption(m.choiceText + " · saved, the screen follows shortly Back: live view") else showCaption(m.choiceText + " · not saved (" + code.ToStr() + ") Back: live view") end if end sub
sub showImage(item as Object) uri = host() + item.image if m.peek.uri <> uri then m.peek.uri = uri m.peek.visible = true end sub
sub showItem() item = m.items[m.index] showImage(item) position = m.index + 1 text = "Up/Down " + position.ToStr() + " of " + m.items.Count().ToStr() + " · " + item.title if item.showing <> invalid and item.showing = true then text = text + " · on screen now" showCaption(text + " Back: live view") end sub
sub showCaption(text as String) m.caption.text = text m.bar.visible = true end sub
' "start" restarts a running Timer. Do not set "stop" first: a stop and a ' start in the same callback leave the Timer stopped (seen on Roku OS 15.3). sub restartIdle() m.idleTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub closePeek() m.idleTimer.control = "stop" m.postTimer.control = "stop" m.pending = invalid m.mode = "" m.peek.visible = false m.bar.visible = false m.index = -1 end sub
